en: A monochrome postcard reproducing Leonardo da Vinci's mural "The Last Supper." The long rectangular image shows Jesus and the twelve apostles seated at a table inside a refectory with a coffered ceiling and three rear windows. Along the right vertical margin there is printed text in Italian and another language describing the work, mentioning "S. Maria delle Grazie," "Leonardo da Vinci" and dates. The postcard has a simple border and no handwriting on the front.
